ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels and 30% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation localized to the medial and central fluke regions. A prominent contiguous high-intensity white patch is mapped to the distal tip of the right lobe. Multiple localized, circular high-intensity blobs (rosettes) are distributed throughout the dark fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression; vertex angle approximately 135 degrees; the precise convergence point is partially obscured by local water spray and turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys ranges from 4 to 18 pixels; serrations appear more pronounced and jagged on the left lobe lobe relative to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge boundaries, sweeping upward and outward from the central notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters localized on the distal half of the right lobe; secondary sparse clustering observed on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible; distinct diagonal mark on the upper-mid region of the left lobe and multiple horizontal rake-like marks on the central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular scarring and likely barnacle-induced texture on the extreme distal edge of the right lobe; notable deep-set serration on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive saw-tooth profile along the trailing edge with non-uniform, jagged topography that deviates from standard smooth-curved specimens.
